title: First week done — thanks everyone!
body: Just wrapped my first week. The welcome session was great and my team has been super friendly. Excited for the term!

comments.body: Same here, loved the welcome lunch!
So glad to hear it, Alex. Reach out any time.

title: Loving the analytics work so far
body: My team gave me a real project on day three — building a churn model. Feels meaningful and I'm learning a ton. Really happy I picked this placement.

comments.body: Same team, it's been awesome so far!

title: Grad cohort lunch was great
body: Thanks to whoever organized the new grad lunch. Great to meet people across teams. Would love more of these!

comments.body: +1, let's make it monthly
Noted! We'll look at a monthly cadence.

title: Excited about the rotation program
body: Started my first rotation in Wealth Management. The learning curve is steep but my mentor is fantastic. Looking forward to growing here.

title: Anyone up for a Friday coffee walk?
body: I'm on the Enterprise Risk floor. Would love to meet more co-ops — anyone up for a coffee walk Friday?

comments.body: I'm in! Same floor.
Count me in

title: Still waiting on system access (week 2)
body: It's my second week and I still don't have access to the trading systems I need. My laptop setup took 4 days. Is this normal? I feel like I'm wasting time.

comments.body: Same in Capital Markets Tech. Took me 9 days to get permissions.
Week 3 here and still missing two access requests. Super frustrating.
Thanks for flagging — we're escalating access delays with IT. Please DM me your ticket numbers.

title: Mentorship program is a highlight
body: Got matched with a senior engineer through the mentorship program. Our biweekly chats have been incredibly helpful for my career planning.

comments.body: My mentor is great too!
Where do I sign up? I missed the matching.

title: Hackathon was amazing
body: The early talent hackathon was the best part of my term so far. Great energy, great people, and our team won the people's choice award!

comments.body: Congrats!! That demo was so good
Amazing work, Grace and team!

title: How do people manage sprint deadlines?
body: Our team has a big release coming up. I'm enjoying the work but curious how others balance it. Any tips for staying organized?

comments.body: Time-blocking helps me. Our team is pretty heavy right now too.

title: Book club anyone?
body: Thinking of starting an early talent book club — first pick could be 'Atomic Habits'. Who's in?

comments.body: Yes!
I'd join

title: Reasonable expectations on hours?
body: Is it normal for new grads to be working until 8pm most days? I want to do well but I'm a bit overwhelmed.

comments.body: It's been like that on my team too.
Mine is pretty balanced, 9-5 most days. Might depend on the team.

title: Question about return offer timelines
body: Does anyone know when return offer decisions are communicated for fall co-ops? My manager wasn't sure.

comments.body: Also wondering this!
Heard it varies by team. Would love an official answer.
Same question. The uncertainty is stressful.

title: How often do others get 1:1s?
body: My manager has cancelled our last three 1:1s. I'm remote most days and I don't really get feedback. How often do others meet with their manager?

comments.body: Weekly for me, but my manager is in the office.
Biweekly at best, and often moved.
Weekly. Maybe raise it with HR?

title: Thanks for the lunch & learn on investing
body: Really useful session on personal finance and investing basics. Would love more practical sessions like this.

title: Weekends are becoming normal
body: Our team has been working weekends for three weeks straight because of the release. I'm exhausted and it doesn't seem like it'll end.

comments.body: Same team. It's rough.
Not just your team. Data & Analytics is the same.
Thank you for raising this. We're talking to team leads about sustainable workloads.

title: Shadowing opportunities?
body: Has anyone set up shadowing with other teams? I'd love to see how risk and analytics work together.

comments.body: I'd be happy to host you on Enterprise Risk!

title: Return offers: still no information
body: It's been weeks and still no information on return offers. Some friends at other companies already have theirs. Hard to plan when we're in the dark.

comments.body: Agreed. Clarity would help a lot.
I've started to think about other options just in case.
We hear you. We're pushing for an official timeline to be shared by end of month.

title: Security certification support
body: Does the company cover certification costs (Security+, CISSP)? I'd love to grow in this area.

comments.body: Yes — there's a learning budget. I'll share the link in the events tab.

title: Trivia night recap
body: Trivia night was so fun! Team 'Ctrl Alt Defeat' takes the crown. Thanks for organizing!

comments.body: Rematch next month!

title: Feeling stuck in my rotation
body: Most of my work is formatting reports and updating spreadsheets. I don't feel like I'm learning or having any impact. Is this what the whole rotation will be like?

comments.body: Talk to your rotation lead, mine adjusted my scope when I asked.
Same experience in my first rotation honestly.

title: Documentation is outdated
body: Most of the onboarding documentation on our team wiki is outdated. I've spent days figuring out setup steps that no longer apply.

comments.body: Could we crowdsource an updated co-op setup guide?
Happy to contribute

title: Shoutout to the D&A team
body: Big thanks to my team for being so welcoming and patient. I've learned so much about data engineering in a few months.

title: Volunteering day was meaningful
body: Loved spending the day at the food bank with other co-ops. Really nice to connect outside of work.

title: Considering other offers
body: I really liked my placement but with no word on return offers, I've started interviewing elsewhere. I'd rather stay but I can't wait forever. I feel undervalued in this process.

comments.body: Thank you for trusting us with this. Can we set up a quick chat this week? No pressure — we want to help.

title: Burned out
body: I'm burned out. Late nights every day, weekends, and no end in sight. I'm starting to regret taking this job. Does anyone else feel like this?

comments.body: Yes. Honestly exhausted too.
Hang in there. We should raise this as a team.
This is important — please reach out to me directly, we want to fix this.

title: Feeling isolated working remote
body: I barely talk to anyone on my team. Most people are remote, my manager is always busy, and I feel invisible. Pretty lonely term so far.

comments.body: Come sit with us on Tuesdays! We're on 12.
Same feeling. Remote co-op terms are hard.

title: Not sure I see a future here
body: I don't feel valued and there's no growth in my role. I got another offer from a fintech and I'm seriously considering it. I'd like to talk to someone before deciding.

comments.body: Thank you for telling us. I'd love to talk this week — I'll reach out to set up time.

title: Good news: access issues fixed for our team
body: After escalating, our team finally got all the access we needed. Thanks HR and IT!

comments.body: Great to hear!

title: Still frustrated with setup
body: I'm two months in and still have one access request pending. Honestly feels like nobody owns this. It's demotivating.

comments.body: That's awful. Have you tried the IT escalation form?

title: Great town hall today
body: Really appreciated leadership taking questions from early talent at the town hall. Felt heard.

comments.body: Agreed, good session

title: Workload is unsustainable
body: I'm overwhelmed. I've been asking for help prioritizing but every task is urgent. I'm exhausted by Thursday every week.

comments.body: Same. I don't know how long I can keep this up.
Would a team-wide prioritization session help? Happy to raise in our grad council.

title: Still waiting on return offers
body: Still nothing official on return offers. Several of us are interviewing now. The silence is pushing good people to look elsewhere.

comments.body: Yep. I accepted an interview elsewhere this week.
Same boat. I'd love to come back but need certainty.

title: I might quit
body: I'm thinking about quitting. The workload is crushing and I'm miserable. I don't want to leave the company but I can't keep doing this.

comments.body: Thank you for reaching out. I'm going to contact you directly today. Your wellbeing comes first.

title: Manager never available
body: Another 1:1 cancelled. I've had one real conversation with my manager this whole term. I'm unhappy and not sure I'd come back.

comments.body: Sorry you're dealing with this.
Maybe the program team can help set up a mentor?

title: Learning budget is great
body: Used the learning budget for a cloud certification. Super grateful this exists — highly recommend!

comments.body: Thanks for the reminder, signing up now

title: Rotation scope still unchanged
body: Asked for more meaningful work two weeks ago. Nothing changed. I feel undervalued and it's a dead end for me.

comments.body: That's frustrating, sorry. Maybe escalate to the program lead?

title: Holiday party planning
body: Anyone want to help plan the early talent holiday party? Looking for 3-4 volunteers!

comments.body: Me!
I can help with decorations

title: Finally got access!
body: Two months later, I finally have all my access. Things are better now but I hope future co-ops have a smoother start.

comments.body: Yay! Let's write that setup guide.

title: Accepted an interview at another bank
body: I'm in final rounds with another bank. I'd still prefer to stay but I can't wait any longer for a return offer decision.

comments.body: Really hope they sort the return offers soon. Good luck either way.

title: Another weekend lost
body: Worked all weekend again. Exhausted, burned out, and I'm job hunting now. Something has to change.

comments.body: I hear you. It's not sustainable.

title: Coffee chat with the CIO
body: Huge thanks for organizing the coffee chat with the CIO. Very inspiring and approachable.

title: Not coming back
body: I don't think I'm coming back next term. I've felt isolated the whole time and nobody checks in. I'm unhappy and wanted HR to know.

title: Mid-term reflections
body: Halfway through and grateful for the learning. Would love clearer info on return offers, but overall a positive experience.

comments.body: Same, mostly positive!
